model: EmbeddingGemma 2 cut to its first 4 layers, distilled 10 epochs onto EG2 q4 query vectors, vocabulary grown to 67,347 tokens with learned rows, then fine-tuned 1 epoch on Bluesky alt text (oaustegard/experiments eg2-vocab-codebook, build v64k_rhq, 2026-10-23)
space: EG2 q4 (onnx-community/embeddinggemma-2-ONNX model_q4.onnx) query vectors, 768-d; documents stay EG2
tokenize: tokenizer.json (67K vocabulary, byte fallback) on prompt + text, including its special-token post-processing (BOS); truncate ids to max_tokens
table: rhq: row = scale * s * H(levels[codes]), H the orthonormal 512-point Walsh-Hadamard transform, s fixed signs; rows [0, n3) 3-bit codes, the rest 2-bit; one fp16 scale per row (eg2-vocab-codebook/run/rhq.py)

files.model_rhq.bin: q4 layers (MatMulNBits layout) + rhq token table; run by engine.js only, through manifest.json

text_to_image_heldout.note: 1,035 alt-text queries whose images were held out of training (sha1(cid) % 5 == 0), over this page's 16,878-image index
